title: jmap-metadata-server clippy::unnecessary_map_or fires on metadata.rs:787 — use is_none_or
description:
Pre-existing clippy failure surfaced during workspace-wide clippy gate run after JMAP-3t94 work.

Location: crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/metadata.rs:787:13

```rust
err.get("properties").map_or(true, Value::is_null),
```

clippy fires `clippy::unnecessary_map_or` (implied by -D warnings). Mechanical fix:

```rust
err.get("properties").is_none_or(Value::is_null),
```

Surfaced when running `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings`. Pre-existing in main (predates the JMAP-3t94 commits 5d516e1 and 8ecc0eb). Sibling crates may have the same shape — quick sweep before fixing:

```bash
rg 'map_or\\(true,' crate-jmap-*-server/src/
```

is_none_or stabilised in Rust 1.82. Verify the workspace MSRV (Cargo.toml rust-version) admits 1.82+ before adopting.

P3 — clippy failure blocks the workspace-wide -D warnings gate but does not affect runtime correctness or wire-protocol behavior. Independent of JMAP-3t94 scope (which was sharing-server only).
close_reason: triage 2026-10-22 (already_fixed, skeptic-confirmed): Fixed in 2415e2db 'refactor(jmap-metadata-server): use is_none_or instead of map_or(true, ...)'. The file was later rewritten (b34a07bf). `cargo clippy -p jmap-metadata-server -p jmap-chat-server --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes at HEAD. The remaining `map_or(true` sites (chat message.rs:578/695/1124, federation deliver.rs:975/1083) are on Result, where clippy does not fire. | check: metadata.rs no longer exists (the metadata-server src is only changes/filter/lib/validate). The remaining `map_or(true` sites are on Result<u64,_>, where unnecessary_map_or does not fire. Clippy with -D warnings on jmap-metadata-server --all-targets exits 0.
